title: The protective effects and material basis of Astragalus membranaceus in the prevention and treatment of radiation-induced lung injury via modulation of the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling pathway.
authors: Yao, Juan; Wang, Huiqin; Zheng, Zhibo; Yang, Juan; Ma, Jiaqi; Zhang, Qi; Liu, Yongqi; Jin, Xiaojie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪通过Keap1-Nrf2通路缓解放射性肺损伤，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Astragalus membranaceus (AM), first documented in "Shennong Bencao Jing", is used in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) to tonify lung qi. Radiation-induced lung injury (RILI), a serious complication of thoracic radiotherapy, lacks effective treatment options, highlighting the need to explore AM's therapeutic potential and material basis against RILI. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to systematically investigate the protective effects of AM against RILI, identify its material basis, and elucidate the underlying mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Male C57BL/6 mice received a single 15 Gy whole-thorax X-ray irradiation to establish an RILI model. The protective effect of AM on RILI was assessed via pulmonary function tests, lung index measurement, hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining, Masson's trichrome staining, and microcomputed tomography (micro-CT) of the mouse lungs. Inflammatory and fibrotic markers were determined using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunohistochemistry (IHC), Western blotting (WB), and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). To explore the mechanism, nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and the expression of its downstream antioxidant proteins were assessed using immunofluorescence (IF), WB, and RT-qPCR. The metabolic components of AM in lung tissue were detected by UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations predicted bioactive candidates, which were then validated in cellular assays. RESULTS: AM treatment significantly ameliorated RILI, as evidenced by improved lung function, reduced lung index, and attenuated histological injury, inflammation, and fibrosis. Mechanistically, AM activated Nrf2 and upregulated the expression of its downstream antioxidant proteins, including heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) and NAD(P)H: quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1). Metabolomic analysis identified 86 AM-related components in lung tissue. Computational screening and MD simulations demonstrated that Formononetin (FMNT) exhibits a stable binding affinity for Keap1 protein. Cell experiments confirmed that FMNT exerts a significant anti-inflammatory effect, which can be reversed by Nrf2 inhibitors. CONCLUSION: AM protects against RILI by activating the Nrf2 signaling pathway to alleviate oxidative stress and inflammation. FMNT is likely the active component underlying its therapeutic effects. This study provides a scientific basis for the traditional use of AM in lung disorders.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：黄芪（Astragalus membranaceus, AM），最早记载于《神农本草经》，在中医（Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM）中用于补肺气。放射性肺损伤（radiation-induced lung injury, RILI）是胸部放疗的严重并发症，目前缺乏有效治疗手段，因此亟需探索AM对RILI的治疗潜力及其物质基础。研究目的：本研究旨在系统探讨AM对RILI的保护作用，明确其物质基础，并阐明潜在机制。材料与方法：雄性C57BL/6小鼠接受单次15 Gy全胸X射线照射以建立RILI模型。通过肺功能测试、肺指数测定、苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin, HE）染色、Masson三色染色及小鼠肺部显微计算机断层扫描（microcomputed tomography, micro-CT）评估AM对RILI的保护作用。采用酶联免疫吸附测定（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, ELISA）、免疫组织化学（immunohistochemistry, IHC）、蛋白质印迹（Western blotting, WB）和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction, RT-qPCR）检测炎症和纤维化标志物。为探索机制，通过免疫荧光（immunofluorescence, IF）、WB和RT-qPCR评估核因子E2相关因子2（nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2, Nrf2）及其下游抗氧化蛋白的表达。采用UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS检测肺组织中AM的代谢成分。分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟预测生物活性候选物，并在细胞实验中验证。结果：AM治疗显著改善RILI，表现为肺功能改善、肺指数降低，以及组织学损伤、炎症和纤维化减轻。机制上，AM激活Nrf2并上调其下游抗氧化蛋白的表达，包括血红素加氧酶-1（heme oxygenase-1, HO-1）和NAD(P)H:醌氧化还原酶1（NAD(P)H: quinone oxidoreductase 1, NQO1）。代谢组学分析在肺组织中鉴定出86种AM相关成分。计算筛选和MD模拟表明，芒柄花素（Formononetin, FMNT）对Keap1蛋白表现出稳定的结合亲和力。细胞实验证实，FMNT具有显著的抗炎作用，该作用可被Nrf2抑制剂逆转。结论：AM通过激活Nrf2信号通路减轻氧化应激和炎症，从而保护RILI。FMNT可能是其治疗作用的关键活性成分。本研究为AM在肺部疾病中的传统应用提供了科学依据。
